# Get Booked Out

> 24/7 AI receptionist for Australian service businesses — answers calls, replies to texts and website messages, and books appointments straight into your calendar.

Get Booked Out is an Australian-built AI receptionist for any business that takes bookings by phone, text, or web chat: trades, salons, clinics, real estate, automotive, hospitality, professional services and more. Plans start from $99/week with no lock-in contracts and a first-month money-back guarantee.
